throughline.zh: 新加坡 HBM 製程設備與半導體檢測廠房完成新里程碑，台灣則公布工具機訂單、製程材料產能規劃以及越南製造與電網資金進度。
throughline.en: Singapore reported new HBM tool and semiconductor-inspection facility milestones, while Taiwan disclosed machine-tool orders, process-material plans and Vietnam manufacturing and grid-funding developments.

title.zh: 新加坡 HBM 封裝及設備製造
title.en: Singapore HBM packaging and equipment manufacturing

summary.zh: 美光於 11 月 19 日將首台 HBM 製程設備移入新廠無塵室，預計 2027 年初產出。KLA 於 11 月 20 日啟用宏茂橋 22B 廠房，新增 21 萬平方英尺；兩案已完成的工程里程碑與未來量產、聘僱目標分開呈現。
summary.en: Micron moved its first HBM packaging tool into a Singapore cleanroom on November 19, while KLA opened its new 210,000-square-foot Ang Mo Kio building on November 20. Completed milestones are distinct from future output and hiring plans.

title.zh: 智慧製造工具機與腔體設備供應鏈
title.en: Smart manufacturing and semiconductor chamber tools

summary.zh: 經濟部 11 月 21 日說明智慧製造計畫近三年累計成果，其中國產五軸半導體腔體工具機已獲德國客戶 30 台訂單。政府估計約 4.5 億元相關產值，機台交付及驗收尚未公開。
summary.en: MOEA reported cumulative smart-manufacturing results, including 30 orders from a German customer for Taiwan-developed semiconductor chamber machine tools. Estimated production value is NT$450 million, with deliveries and acceptance undisclosed.

title.zh: 電子特氣與 TGV 玻璃封裝材料
title.en: Specialty gases and TGV glass packaging

summary.zh: 晶呈科技公布第三季特殊氣體出貨 6,898 支鋼瓶，第四季提出更高的出貨預估。TGV 製程現有八條線並規劃 2027 年底增至十二條，頭份 C4F6 新廠仍在建置。
summary.en: Jingcheng reported 6,898 Q3 specialty-gas cylinders, with higher Q4 guidance. Its eight TGV lines are targeted to expand to twelve by end-2027, while its Toufen C4F6 plant is still being built.

title.zh: 越南製造業資本與機電工程
title.en: Vietnam manufacturing capital and electromechanical contracts

summary.zh: 訊芯香港 11 月 20 日核准增資越南子公司 2,000 萬美元，GIS-KY 越南子公司另公告 5.30442 億元機電安裝工程契約。股權增資與工程採購屬不同交易性質，兩案均未公布量產驗收。
summary.en: ShunSin Hong Kong approved a US$20 million Vietnam equity injection on November 20, while GIS-KY disclosed a NT$530.442 million electromechanical installation agreement in Vietnam. The equity and construction contracts are distinct measures, without qualified production milestones.

title.zh: 台灣公用電力預算與電價程序
title.en: Taiwan utility financing and tariff review

summary.zh: 立法院 11 月 20 日通過包含撥補台電 711 億元的追加預算，台電表示後續將提供燃料成本及財務資料供電價審議。12 月電價仍待決議，沒有新的產業用電費率或個別電網設備採購額。
summary.en: Taiwan passed a supplementary budget including NT$71.1 billion for Taipower on November 20. The utility will submit cost information to the tariff review, with December rates and project-level grid procurements still unconfirmed.
